name: scandeck
description: Two-sided leaf scanning for the Epson Perfection V370: auto scan area from a prescan (OpenVINO YOLO), TapeDeck-style leaf IDs, JPEG XL masters, calibration gallery.

scripts.probe:build: swiftc -swift-version 5 -O -o probe/icprobe probe/icprobe.swift && swiftc -swift-version 5 -O -o probe/qrtool probe/qrtool.swift
scripts.ov:build: P=$(brew --prefix openvino) && for t in ovdetect ovseg; do clang -O2 -o probe/$t probe/$t.c -I$P/include -L$P/lib -lopenvino_c -Wl,-rpath,$P/lib || exit 1; done

author: William Weaver
